name: Vitória

queries.query: Vitória ES prefeitura mapa lotes cadastrais GIS serviço ArcGIS mapa base imobiliário
queries.scope: Find the official municipal parcel layer and anonymous full geometry endpoint.
queries.result: Official municipal ArcGIS exposes a public Lote polygon layer (MapServer layer 101) in the city’s Mapa Base Imobiliário. The queued WUP point returned an empty feature collection; a central Vitória point returned current full polygons. Layer has 51,643 records and supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF queries.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search and read-only service inspection.

queries.query: Vitoria Brazil official municipal cadastral lots parcel map public ArcGIS
queries.scope: Cross-check public layer, ownership, and data-access distinction.
queries.result: The city-hosted ArcGIS layer is attributable to Vitória municipal mapping and serves full parcel polygons. The separate property-control portal is an administrative workflow and was not used for property-owner queries.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search and read-only service inspection.

portals.name: Mapa Base Imobiliário de Vitória – Lote
portals.operator: Prefeitura Municipal de Vitória; municipal ArcGIS service
portals.observation: Public polygon layer in EPSG:31984 with 51,643 records, full municipal extent, JSON/GeoJSON/PBF query support. Safe attributes used were OBJECTID, codGeo, codLote and codGeoPoligono only.

portals.name: Espelho do Cadastro Imobiliário
portals.observation: Confirms municipal property-cadastre context; separate administrative portal was not queried for personal or property records.

requests.observation: Layer metadata reports Lote polygon geometry, EPSG:31984, 51,643 records, object-ID query, JSON/GeoJSON/PBF formats.
Exact WUP point query returned zero parcels.
Returns full polygon for safe composite identity codGeo=44208, codLote=17729. Native IDs are municipality parcel/lot fields; OBJECTID is transport/paging only.

verifiedParcelResponse.locationBasis: Bounded local sample near city center; queried at [-40.3128,-20.3155], not at WUP point [-40.3424142,-20.3291778]. WUP exact point returned zero.
verifiedParcelResponse.attributePolicy: Only OBJECTID, codGeo, codLote, codGeoPoligono requested; no owner/address fields.

source.name: Vitória municipal Mapa Base Imobiliário Lote
source.coordinateReferenceSystem: EPSG:31984; query responses GeoJSON in EPSG:4326
source.scope: 127 valid, distinct municipal Lote references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells at the separately identified central Vitória reference [-20.3155,-40.3128]. The unchanged WUP locator has no exact-point parcel. Complete object-ID manifests, 31-row forced three-row paging over eleven geometry pages, all 127 fresh composite codGeo/codLote identities, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed in 21 checks. Native EPSG:31984 re-reads confirm four tiny source boundary-sliver pairs totaling 0.37279 m²; the largest pair is 0.17233 m², the largest fraction is 0.03197% of the smaller parcel, and overlap-part inscribed diameters are 0.00092–0.01331 m (GEOS tolerance 0.0001 m). Root accepts these documented narrow slivers for bounded reference use, consistent with the Philadelphia review. All original coordinates remain unchanged; no repair, clipping, snapping or selective deletion. Citywide completeness, source-wide identity uniqueness, survey accuracy and legal-title extent remain unverified.
